_metadata.description: Programmatic application of brand elements into a target scenario (CSS markers, manifest _brand keys, asset copy) plus DESIGN.md export.

requirements.title: Apply colors and typography via marked CSS custom properties
requirements.description: Apply writes brand colors and typography as CSS custom properties delimited by /* brand-manager:<element> */ markers, replacing only the marked region so unrelated CSS is preserved.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/apply/css_test.go once the marker-based apply engine is ported.

requirements.title: Apply manifest _brand keys and copy static assets atomically
requirements.description: Apply sets manifest.json _brand keys and favicon paths and copies brand static assets into the target scenario atomically, so a failed apply does not leave the target half-branded.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/apply/manifest_test.go once manifest/asset apply is ported.

requirements.title: Re-applying an unchanged brand is idempotent
requirements.description: Applying the same brand version twice produces no second diff: marked regions, manifest keys, and copied assets are byte-identical on the second run.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/apply/idempotency_test.go once apply idempotency is ported.

requirements.title: Export a root-level DESIGN.md during apply
requirements.description: Apply renders a root-level DESIGN.md for the target scenario from structured brand data plus user notes, regenerating it deterministically on each apply.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/apply/designdoc_test.go once DESIGN.md export is ported.
